contents.content:
Bellandur is a promising residential real estate destination that offers a strategic location, booming IT sector, social infrastructure affordable prices, upcoming metro connectivity, green spaces and lakes and safety and convenience.

Table of Contents

1. Strategic Location
2.Booming it sector
3.Social Infrastructure
4.Affordable Prices
5.Upcoming Metro Connectivity
6.Green Spaces and Lakes
7.Safety & Convenience
8.Conclusion
9.FAQS
 

Key Takeaways  

  • Bellandur is a promising residential real estate destination in Bangalore.
  • The suburb’s strategic location, booming IT sector, social infrastructure, and affordable prices, upcoming metro connectivity, green spaces and lakes and safety and convenience make it an ideal location for investment.
  • Investing in Bellandur offers high returns on investment and potential for high appreciation rates.

1.Strategic Location  

Bellandur  is on the Outer Ring Road (ORR), which connects to Whitefield and Silk Board. These are two important areas in Bangalore. Bellandur also links to Marathahalli and the Old Airport Road.

Some nearby railway stations are:

  • Karmelaram, which is 5 km away via Doddakannelli - Kadubeesanahalli Road
  • Bellandur Road
  • Baiyyappanahalli
    If you want to go to Kempegowda International Airport, it is about 49 km away via NH 44.
    Bellandur has well-built roads and highways, so getting around is easy. You can also take BMTC buses to important places like:
  • Majestic
  • Shanthi Nagar
  • Whitefield
  • KR Market
  • Electronic City
  • Kempegowda International Airport

2. Booming IT Sector

Bellandur is a suburb in Bangalore. It has many IT parks, such as Ecospace Business park Bellandur. Some big IT companies like Cisco, Wipro, SAP Labs, Intel, and AT&T are here. Bellandur is on the Outer Ring Road. This makes it easy to reach other important places in Bangalore, like Whitefield, ITPL, and Electronic City. Bellandur is also close to many Special Economic Zones (SEZs). This makes it a good place to invest in property. The IT growth in Bellandur has increased the property value.

3. Social Infrastructure  

Bellandur is a suburb in Bangalore. It has many IT parks, malls, and other places to have fun. Some of the best schools here are Patel Public School and Green Dot Montessori. You can also find good hospitals like Sakra World Hospital and Columbia Asia Hospital. One of the most popular malls in Bellandur is Soul Space Spirit Centro Mall.

4. Affordable Prices  

Bellandur is still considered to be one of the developing suburbs in Bangalore. The properties in this region are priced at low introductory prices, making it an ideal location for investment. The suburb’s high appreciation rates and potential for high returns make it a smart choice for investors.

Renting a place in Bellandur can cost you different amounts depending on the type and size. Here's a quick breakdown: 

  • For a 1 BHK flat, expect around ₹15,764 per month.
  • If you're eyeing a 2 BHK, the average rent goes up to ₹42,839 monthly.
  • A 3 BHK might set you back around ₹72,667 each month.
  • Independent houses, on the other hand, have an average rent of ₹15,400 per month.
    According to MagicBricks.com,  the highest locality price is ₹12,968 per square foot, the average locality price is ₹10,057 per square foot, and the lowest locality price is ₹7,147 per square foot. 

5. Upcoming Metro Connectivity

Looking ahead to better transportation, the upcoming Namma Metro Phase 2A (BlueLine) aims to make traveling between Silk Board and KR Puram much easier. This addition to the Namma Metro project will significantly improve getting around the Outer Ring Road (ORR) area with 13 new stations planned.
Bellandur is a key part of this plan, being one of the 13 important stations. The inclusion of Bellandur highlights its advantage in connectivity, making it a central hub that connects the area to different parts of the city. The new Metro station in Bellandur is expected to change daily commutes and make it much easier to get around.
Known as the ORR Metro Line or Blue Line, this extension is designed to make traveling smoother for everyone. Bellandur's station isn't just a single milestone; it's part of a bigger plan to make transferring between different Metro lines easy – one to the extended Purple Line at KR Puram and another to the proposed RV Road – Bommasandra line (Yellow Line) at Silk Board.

6. Green Spaces and Lakes

Bellandur is a suburb in Bangalore. It has grown fast, but it still has lakes and green spaces. One of them is Bellandur Lake. The lake has some problems, but it is important for the area. Bellandur has both urban development and greenery. This makes it a nice place to live and invest.

7.Safety & Convenience

Bellandur is a busy area with many ATMs, banks, and police stations. The road from Bellandur to Marathahalli is safe and convenient for everyone. It is also good for people who live with older family members, because they can easily find what they need. The people in this area enjoy celebrating different events and festivals. They have a friendly community in their residential complexes.

8. Conclusion

Bellandur is a good place to invest in. It shows how fast Bangalore is growing. It has a lot of business, better roads and transportation. If you want to invest in property, Bellandur is a smart choice because it has many good things.

9. Frequently Asked Questions

Q. What are the benefits of investing in Bellandur?
A. Bellandur is a great place to invest your money. It has a good location, a strong IT sector, and many social amenities. It also has low prices and high growth rates. You can get high returns if you invest in Bellandur.

Q. What is the strategic location of Bellandur?
A. Bellandur is located at the center of Whitefield and Silk Board, two of the leading localities in Bangalore. It is also well-connected to other major hubs of the city.
